label: end-of-episode ramp (last ~10 trials), mostly at D2 after choosing a1 and at the following unrewarded D1
explanation: An end-of-episode unit. 99.6% of activation mass falls on trials 90-99 (essentially none before trial 85), and every active step has the model value output in its lowest bin (<5.2), so it tracks the episode running out. Within that window it is close to silent at GO (1.5% of mass) and fires on D2 (65%) and D1 (34%). It strongly prefers a1: in_action=a1 has 3.8x lift and 64% of mass, while a2 inputs carry about 1%. Activation builds up over consecutive a1 trials. It peaks at D2 after a1 (largest when the transition was rare, S2R), then at the next D1, especially when that D1 shows no reward. It decays fast once the agent switches to a2. Recorded predicate (all observed variables; ep_trial is not observed directly but the network could track it internally): late episode and (D2 after a1, or D1 after an a1 trial with no reward shown). Dev scores: P 0.39, R 0.69, F1 0.50, mass recall 0.80. Late episode alone gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.10. Misses are low-magnitude D1 and D2 steps late in a1 streaks and some a2 trials. False positives are late a1 steps with no build-up yet, e.g. the first a1 after a2 trials. This looks like a magnitude-coded integrator of late-episode a1 history more than a clean binary event.
